name: University of Niagara Falls
description:
Are you looking to join a digital-oriented institution that will groom you in leadership? The University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF) welcomes you!


UNF is a creative, tech-oriented university that prioritises you through its digital-centred teaching method and provides an advanced learning framework suitable for today’s technological progress.


Its integrated programs focus on the constantly changing requirements of the global workforce. 

About the University

UNF is located in Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada, and is dedicated to innovative academic programs.

UNF provides five exclusive postgraduate and undergraduate programs tailored to meet the requirements of your academic success. These distinctive programs are:

  • Honours Bachelor of Science
  • Honours Bachelor of Business Administration
  • Master of Data Analytics
  • Master of Management 
  • Master of Arts in Digital Media and Global Communications

UNF is a growing university that operates in the centre of an engaging student community. These communities will help you get substantial opportunities to research, learn, and upgrade your skills.

Student life

You can team up with the student support community by connecting with them and engaging in various activities and events.
 

The University of Niagara Falls Canada conducts the New Student Orientation during your first week at the UNF.


You can learn about UNF’s new opportunities, environment, fellows, and process quickly. It lets you know about the new school, surroundings, and peers, and make the most of your time at UNF.

Why choose the University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF)?

  1. UNF has excellent, passionate faculty with comprehensive industry experience who will guide you throughout your educational and career paths. 
  2. Its modern campus infrastructure incorporates the tools and resources needed for your program studies and research.
  3. Its customised program has effective majors that stimulate your education journey and suit your preferred professional development. 
  4. UNF encourages your academic performance by providing awards and education scholarships. The office of the registrar provides over $5 million to eligible students through scholarships and awards in 2024.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UNF has housing partners providing affordable, comfortable, and suitable accommodation for you. You get inclusive support throughout your academic journey. You can contact the UNF housing coordinator for accommodation-related information. The housing partners for UNF are:

  • 4Stay
  • SpacesShared
  • Niagara Homestay

Comprehensive housing support begins before you arrive in Ontario and continues throughout your studies at UNF. Its Housing Coordinator supports your search for off-campus housing and other housing-related matters through one-to-one meetings, live sessions, and email.

UNF’s residence is located on Lundy’s Lane in Niagara Falls. Double and single occupancy rooms are available in its residence. Your application will be approved for spring, summer, and fall intakes. The rooms will be distributed to students on a first-come, first-serve basis.

The rooms have study desks, chairs, twin-sized beds, and wardrobes for each student. Each room has kitchen amenities, study lounges and onsite laundry facilities.

Moreover, UNF’s enthusiastic faculties are ready to provide a safe and comfortable environment. Through their support, social activities and community events are conducted to encourage overall development.
